name: Lore Distance Relationship: Coming Out In 3D
source:
In this mini-sequel to Lore Distance Relationship, Bea visits Kayla's dorm, and they check out the newest Ruffians feature: Make-A-Home.  There, new discoveries are made, and their love for each other deepens.

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/lore-distance-relationship-coming-out-in-3d]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部《远距离关系》的迷你续集中，碧拜访了凯拉的宿舍，并与他们一起体验了最新的《恶棍》专题：“打造家园”。在那里，有了新的发现，他们对彼此的爱也加深了。
